subject: gk
question:
Which of the following statements is correct regarding the ninth five-year plan of India?

I. The plan focused on growth with social justice and equality.

II. The time period of the ninth-five-year plan is 1997-2002.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Ninth Five-Year Plan of India aimed at achieving growth with social justice and equality.
 
• The duration of the Ninth Five-Year Plan was from 1997 to 2002.
 
• This plan was launched after the economic reforms of the 1990s and was influenced by the economic liberalization policies introduced during that period.
 
• The plan emphasized the importance of sustainable development and the equitable distribution of resources.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Five-Year Plans in India**

 
 
• India's Five-Year Plans were centralized and integrated national economic programs. They were modeled after the Soviet Union's planning system.
 
• The first such plan was launched in 1951, and the last (12th) plan was from 2012 to 2017.
 
• These plans aimed at economic growth, modernization, self-reliance, and social justice.
 
 
 
• **Ninth Five-Year Plan (1997-2002)**
 
 
• This plan was launched under the leadership of then Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee.
 
• It aimed to achieve a growth rate of 6.5% per annum.
 
• It focused on agriculture and rural development with a view to generate adequate employment and eradicate poverty.
 
• The plan also aimed at containing population growth, ensuring food and nutritional security, providing basic minimum services of safe drinking water, primary health care facilities, universal primary education, and shelter to all.
 
• Special attention was given to the empowerment of women and socially disadvantaged groups such as Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), and Other Backward Classes (OBC).
 
 
 
• **Economic Liberalization**
 
 
• Economic liberalization in India refers to the economic reforms introduced in 1991.
 
• These reforms were aimed at opening up the Indian economy to global markets, reducing the control of the state over the economy, and encouraging private enterprise.
 
• The reforms included measures such as deregulation, reduction of import tariffs, and the removal of subsidies.
